primary_endpoint: At Week 24: histological NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis, and ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement without worsening of NASH.
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution: 5 (15 mg QW), 12 (30 mg QW), and 11 (44 mg Q2W) vs 1 pooled placebo; p<0.0001, p=0.0009, and p=0.0005, respectively. Fibrosis improvement: 3, 14, and 11 vs 4 pooled placebo; p=0.1039, p=0.0085, and p=0.0077, respectively.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 1/21 (15 mg QW), 5/72 (30 mg QW), and 8/57 (44 mg Q2W); placebo groups 6/50 and 2/19. No deaths reported.
